paper:2025-50dd65d936.abstract: GaussianImage++ enhances 2D Gaussian splatting with compact quantized representations for fast and high-fidelity image compression.
paper:2025-50dd65d936.title: GaussianImage++ Boosted Image Representation and Compression with 2D Gaussian Splatting
paper:2025-50dd65d936.tldr: GaussianImage++ enhances 2D Gaussian splatting with compact quantized representations for fast and high-fidelity image compression.

paper:2025-69e3dabf00.abstract: Employs coarse-to-fine frequency modulation during 3D Gaussian optimization to eliminate floating artifacts and enhance fine details.
paper:2025-69e3dabf00.title: Optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting using Coarse-to-Fine Image Frequency Modulation
paper:2025-69e3dabf00.tldr: Employs coarse-to-fine frequency modulation during 3D Gaussian optimization to eliminate floating artifacts and enhance fine details.

paper:2025-b0b96b4fa9.abstract: A feedforward monocular view synthesis network producing sharp 3D scene geometry and appearance in under one second.
paper:2025-b0b96b4fa9.title: Sharp Monocular View Synthesis in Less Than a Second
paper:2025-b0b96b4fa9.tldr: A feedforward monocular view synthesis network producing sharp 3D scene geometry and appearance in under one second.

paper:2025-b1690fbb9c.abstract: Develops a Gaussian Splatting pipeline to generate diverse synthetic training datasets for vision-based robotic grasping and manipulation.
paper:2025-b1690fbb9c.title: Computer vision training dataset generation for robotic environments using Gaussian splatting
paper:2025-b1690fbb9c.tldr: Develops a Gaussian Splatting pipeline to generate diverse synthetic training datasets for vision-based robotic grasping and manipulation.

paper:2025-f13a7b00a2.abstract: D4RT introduces a feedforward network for dynamic scene reconstruction, predicting 4D space-time point trajectories from monocular video in real time.
paper:2025-f13a7b00a2.title: Efficiently Reconstructing Dynamic Scenes One D4RT at a Time
paper:2025-f13a7b00a2.tldr: D4RT introduces a feedforward network for dynamic scene reconstruction, predicting 4D space-time point trajectories from monocular video in real time.
